# build output

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:buildOutput`](gmeow-buildOutput.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/buildOutput>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/software`](../../slices/software.md)

The distribution artifact produced by a build activity. Non-functional: a build may produce multiple artifacts (tarball, wheel, binary, container image).
